existing_output_inventory.screened_out_arm: qwen3_8b_base on panel_math at every seed
existing_output_inventory.note: The outputs predate this lock. The current analysis has not inspected receiver R-star orderings, but this is not a prospectively generated panel.

question: Can a frozen-model correction measure predict the rate needed to retain a fixed corpus update across receivers?

frozen_measurement.role: One pre-fine-tuning measurement per receiver-corpus cell; the value is shared by all three training seeds.
frozen_measurement.blind_rule: Do not inspect receiver R-star ordering until all 21 frozen measurements finish and this analysis lock is synced.

primary_target.name: r_star_bits_per_value
primary_target.definition: Smallest exact reloadable adapter rate retaining 90% of held-out NLL gain.
primary_target.note: This rate already removes the mechanical adapter-size difference across receivers.

primary_predictor.name: dataset_fisher_log_volume
primary_predictor.selection: Highest partial development correlation after the fixed token-count and text-redundancy controls.

claim_boundary: This development panel can establish receiver-axis signal and justify a fully untouched corpus. Because its training outputs predate the analysis lock, it cannot count as a prospective prediction or by itself establish prediction on a new receiver-task pair.
